translation: Proceeding downward in order, I retreated and rubbed the philtrum (人中); unexpectedly the bridge of the nose shed its shell and came down, and I immediately rubbed it away. I had not been able to breathe through the nose while lying on my right side for more than ten years, and did not know why; now it suddenly appeared and dispersed. I think it was because the various accumulations gradually cleared and could no longer contain themselves; from this I can lie on my right side. Those with disease of the five sense organs can also seek it in this way.
